title: PqWaveformSummary
description: Hub -> orchestrator, published on <root>/scada/wave/<zone>/<bank_id>/<hub_id>/summary, QoS 0, at the hub's telemetry cadence (06-service-profiles-and-power-quality.md S6.4a). Mirrors og.pq_waveform_summary (orchestrator/migrations/0011_asset_health.sql). Per S6.4a's bandwidth mitigation, a publish may carry only the 'fast' sub-block (RMS/freq/PF/aggregate THD) with harmonics_v/harmonics_i omitted, or the full summary including the harmonic-detail sub-block; both shapes validate against this schema since the harmonics fields are optional. The wire encoding SHOULD be a compact binary/CBOR form of this same shape, not verbose JSON, for bandwidth (S6.4a); this schema is the canonical field definition either way.

sync_quality_ns.description: Estimated clock offset; a summary computed against a poor sync reference must be treated as stale for cross-hub phase comparison (S6.5 risk note).

harmonics.description: Order (2-50, as a string key) -> magnitude (% of fundamental) and angle (degrees, relative to sync_source).
